codes.label: Suggestions contain subtle or invented errors
codes.definition: Suggested code looks right but is wrong, or refers to APIs or flags that do not exist.
codes.include: Wrong logic, invented methods, invented configuration.
codes.exclude: Time spent checking output goes to A-RQ2-03.

anchor_quotes.quote: The suggestions are often wrong in subtle ways
it invents API methods that do not exist

codes.label: Security, licensing and data risks
codes.definition: The developer sees risks to security, licensing or data handling in using the assistant.
codes.include: Insecure suggestions, licence worries, unclear data sharing.
codes.exclude: Rules that restrict use go to A-RQ2-07.

anchor_quotes.quote: I don't trust it with anything security related
Our legal team is nervous about licensing of generated code
I can't tell what data it sends to the vendor

codes.label: Checking its output costs time
codes.definition: Reviewing, editing or chasing the assistant's output takes time that can exceed the time saved.
codes.include: Review time, heavy editing, time lost chasing errors, extra review steps.
codes.exclude: The errors themselves go to A-RQ2-01.

anchor_quotes.quote: Reviewing its output takes longer than writing the code myself

codes.label: Ignores team conventions and internal libraries
codes.definition: Generated code does not follow the team's conventions or fit its internal libraries.
codes.include: Naming conventions, internal libraries, house style.
codes.exclude: Plain wrong code goes to A-RQ2-01.

anchor_quotes.quote: The suggestions rarely fit our internal libraries

codes.label: Erodes developers' own understanding
codes.definition: Relying on suggestions may keep developers from understanding code or keeping their skills.
codes.include: Worries about juniors, deskilling, accepting without understanding.
codes.exclude: Errors in output go to A-RQ2-01.

anchor_quotes.quote: juniors on my team accept suggestions without understanding them
I'm concerned about losing my own skills

codes.label: Interrupts concentration
codes.definition: Suggestions break the developer's flow of thought.

codes.label: Organisation restricts where it may be used
codes.definition: Legal, leads or policy limit the code bases where the assistant may be used, or leave it unclear.
codes.include: Bans, restrictions to internal tools, unclear policy.
codes.exclude: The underlying risk without a rule goes to A-RQ2-02.

anchor_quotes.quote: we can only use it on internal tools
Our team lead banned it on the payments service

discovery/v0/per_reading/analyst_A_RQ2.j.notes: contrastive pass separated rules from risks.
